description: Official specs for a coin or bar: mint, country, fineness, gross and fine weight, pure metal content, denomination and series, with the source for each row and a fine-weight recompute check (gross x purity / 31.1034768). Covers the tracked products plus spec-only coins (pre-1933 $20/$10/$5 gold, Morgan and Peace dollars, PAMP 20 g and 10 g bars). Unknown fields, IRA eligibility and 1099-B reportability come back null and are listed in missing; nothing is estimated.

product.description: Tracked slug or name with weight (see list_products), or a spec-only sku/name such as morgan-dollar, "$20 double eagle" or "pamp 20g".

name: product_spec
title: Coin and bar spec lookup
